scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Dragon Fruit Vikas Yojana
description: The Dragon Fruit Vikas Yojana is a component of the Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission launched by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Bihar. The scheme aims to promote the commercial cultivation of dragon fruit across selected districts of Bihar by providing financial assistance to ryot farmers. It seeks to increase the area under horticultural cultivation, improve farmers' income, and encourage diversification of agriculture through dragon fruit farming.
objectives: Promote commercial cultivation of dragon fruit in Bihar.
Increase the area under horticultural crops.
Provide financial assistance to ryot farmers for dragon fruit cultivation.
Enhance farmers' income through high-value horticulture.

benefits.title: First Year Financial Assistance
benefits.description: ₹1,80,000 per hectare for dragon fruit cultivation.

eligibility.title: Residence
eligibility.description: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Bihar.

eligibility.title: Farmer Category
eligibility.description: The applicant must be a ryot farmer.

eligibility.title: Eligible Districts
eligibility.description: The applicant must belong to one of the following districts: Bhojpur, Gopalganj, Jehanabad, Saran, Siwan, Supaul, Aurangabad, Begusarai, Bhagalpur, Gaya, Katihar, Kishanganj, Munger, Muzaffarpur, Nalanda, West Champaran, Patna, East Champaran, Purnia, Samastipur, or Vaishali.

eligibility.title: Land Requirement
eligibility.description: The applicant must possess agricultural land ranging from a minimum of 0.25 acres (0.1 hectare) to a maximum of 10 acres (4 hectares).

eligibility.title: DBT Registration
eligibility.description: The applicant must be registered on the Bihar DBT portal.

registration_steps.title: Visit DBT Portal
registration_steps.description: Visit the Bihar DBT farmer registration portal.

registration_steps.title: Verify Aadhaar
registration_steps.description: Select Aadhaar verification mode (OTP/BIO-AUTH/IRIS) and authenticate using Aadhaar details.

registration_steps.title: Validate OTP
registration_steps.description: Enter the OTP received and validate it.

registration_steps.title: Confirm KCC Details
registration_steps.description: Verify Kisan Credit Card (KCC) details and proceed with farmer registration.

registration_steps.title: Fill Registration Form
registration_steps.description: Enter farmer details, land information, and bank account details.

registration_steps.title: Submit Registration
registration_steps.description: Validate with OTP and submit the registration to generate a 13-digit DBT Registration ID.

registration_steps.title: Wait for Activation
registration_steps.description: After 48 hours of successful registration, use the DBT Registration Number to apply for the scheme.

application_steps.title: Proceed to Apply
application_steps.description: Scroll down, confirm the declaration checkbox, and click 'Proceed to Apply'.

application_steps.title: Enter Registration Details
application_steps.description: Select the applicant type and enter the 13-digit DBT Registration Number.

application_steps.title: Fill Application Form
application_steps.description: Provide address, land details, and other required information.

application_steps.title: Upload Documents
application_steps.description: Upload all the required supporting documents.

application_steps.title: Submit Application
application_steps.description: Accept the declaration and submit the application.

application_steps.title: Save Application Number
application_steps.description: Note the generated Application Number and print the application for future reference.

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Card
documents_required.remarks: Must be linked with the registered mobile number.

documents_required.name: Passport Size Photograph
documents_required.remarks: Required during both DBT registration and scheme application.

documents_required.name: Land Ownership Certificate / Revenue Receipt
documents_required.remarks: Required during scheme application, if applicable.

documents_required.name: Genealogy Certificate
documents_required.remarks: Required if the applicant's name is not clearly mentioned in the land ownership or revenue receipt.

important_notes: The scheme is available only in 21 notified districts of Bihar.
Farmers must complete DBT registration before applying for the scheme.
Applications are processed on a first-come, first-served basis.
Beneficiary allocation: General Category – 78.56%, Scheduled Castes – 20%, Scheduled Tribes – 1.44%, Women – 30%.
A valid 13-digit DBT Registration Number is mandatory for application.

faqs.question: What financial assistance is provided under the scheme?
faqs.answer: ₹1,80,000 per hectare in the first year, ₹60,000 per hectare in the second year, and ₹60,000 per hectare in the third year.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply?
faqs.answer: Ryot farmers who are residents of Bihar, belong to one of the notified districts, own eligible agricultural land, and are registered on the DBT portal.

faqs.question: Is DBT registration mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes. Farmers must register on the Bihar DBT portal before applying for the scheme.

faqs.question: How are beneficiaries selected?
faqs.answer: Beneficiaries are selected on a first-come, first-served basis.

faqs.question: What is the minimum land requirement?
faqs.answer: Applicants must have at least 0.25 acres (0.1 hectare) of agricultural land.
